text_block_list.text:
Woohoo! It's finally, finally, finally, finally
here!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
It certainly is! The long-awaited Winning
Dream Stage is—
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
An endless wasteland, sprawling ahead...
Untouched gold mines,
mysterious ancient
ruins! Now, take my hand, McQueen! Let's
go on
an adventure!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?! We have a
performance today! A
concert!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Haha, does Golshi ever make sense? It's so
McQueen to snatch the
bait too, but...
What's this?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Earth to Spe?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm here! Is it my time to sing?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Not yet... but are you okay? You look
terribly nervous.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yeah... Just a little, but... I mean, no.
I'm sorry! I'm super nervous!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Up until now, everyone's worked so hard
to prepare for today's event,
so... I don't
wanna ruin it!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Balderdash!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
What do you keep looking back at, Spe?
Are your toes where your
heels should
be?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! My toes are in the front!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I know it can be aggravating trying to
understand what Голд Шип
means to say,
but she has a point, or... a percentage of
one, rather.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
A commemoration is not only about
celebrating the past, but also
paving the
way for the future.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Right. So basically, don't worry so much
about the "up until now,"
'cause we gotta
do our best for the "hereafter"! ♪
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: You'll be fine, Spe. Remember...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Every day, no matter what... we've always
run forward, right?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Don't look back... just keep moving
forward. Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Our thoughts and feelings will be
conveyed through our performance!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик
